obligations.note: The change adds a new read-only helper `approvals_remaining` to payments.py but does not modify the `approve` or `is_fully_approved` functions that enforce maker-checker. The control test `test_maker_cannot_check` passes in CI on the final commit.

The new function calls `required_approvals` but does not alter it or the dual-control threshold logic. The control test `test_dual_control_grid_matches_policy` passes in CI on the final commit, and the acceptance-ledger proof for `required_approvals` (ACR-0401) is not lapsed because the covered symbol is unchanged.

The `release` function in payments.py is not modified by this change. The control test `test_sampled_release_is_idempotent` passes in CI on the final commit, and the ponens-trace evidence (ACR-0403) remains valid.

Ticket CHG-25093 is approved by change manager Grace Kim and lists components `payments.payments` and `payments.tests`, which cover the two files modified (payments.py and test_approvals_remaining.py respectively).
Mara Costa (m.costa@fernbrook.example) is a `change_approver` for payments and is not the author Sofia Santos. Her code_review approval is on the head commit ff24eda.
The single commit ff24eda is the head and the commit named in the approval; there are no later commits to void it.
CI run on the final commit ff24eda shows 175 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. All payments control tests (including those for MC-1, PAY-1, PAY-2) are present, unskipped, and passing.
The new function is additive and does not alter any covered symbol in the acceptance ledger (required_approvals, release, routes.py, audit.py, etc.), so no prior evidence is lapsed.

summary: PR-1511 adds a small, read-only helper `approvals_remaining` and its unit tests to the payments payments module. No existing logic is modified; no security-sensitive component, protected path, or control data is touched. The change has an approved ticket covering both modified components, an independent code_review approval from a non-author change_approver on the head commit, and a CI run on the final commit with all 175 tests (including every payments control test) passing and unskipped. All applicable process and product obligations are satisfied; the change is accepted.
